meta.name: It Gets Worse
meta.description:
Three best friends from college face eviction in London. As they scatter across the city, they navigate friendship, dating disasters, and adulting - all while the world crumbles around them.

Complete series. On your server: S1 6/6

videos.title: Ethan
videos.overview: Newly evicted best friends Ethan, Abi, and Sam are broke, directionless, and scrambling to repair the damage in their London flat before they're thrown out for good. Determined to escape reality with one last unforgettable night out, they hit the club. But the night spirals and long-buried tensions surface. The trio must confront whether their friendship can survive the fallout.

videos.title: Abi
videos.overview: Abi has it all: a nice flat with her boyfriend, a new promotion, a more adult life. But beneath the surface, cracks are beginning to show. Ethan becomes infatuated with Sam's new housemate Aaron. The trio reunite at a chaotic dinner party, which forces Abi to look closer at her seemingly perfect life.

videos.title: Sam
videos.overview: Sam's moral high ground is tested at a warehouse sex party, where she invites her new hook up Tess. Abi attempts to make her boyfriend Tom jealous, whilst Ethan spends the night trying to figure out if Aaron is gay. The trio try to maintain control over their love lives, leading to impulsive decisions that could ruin everything.

videos.title: Everyone Else is Taken
videos.overview: Ethan and Abi show up to support Sam's reading of new work. But when a short film from the warehouse sex party plays, they are forced to confront how much they've changed since meeting. Meanwhile, Ethan and Aaron blur even more boundaries.

videos.title: Stop All The Cocks
videos.overview: Ethan, Abi and Sam attend a funeral for an old friend from university. The funeral brings their love and loneliness to the surface. Abi reflects on her relationship with Tom, Ethan pursues Aaron and Sam wrestles with her guilt. All while their friendship hangs in the balance.

videos.title: People Team
videos.overview: After personal setbacks and the world continuing to fall apart, Ethan, Abi and Sam attempt reconciliation but a chaotic housewarming party at their new flat only reveals that their messy lives are far from resolved. The fresh start begins to feel uncertain - surely it gets better than this. Right? But who needs better, when they have each other...
